cast.name: Avery
cast.role: Protagonist — young woman with severe PTSD and BPD, placed in Lilyale after killing her father. Burn scars on her arm, scarred back from a bottle attack. Hypervigilant, flinches at touch. Her nervous system has been rewired by chronic trauma.
cast.look: Early 20s woman, slight build, long dark hair often falling over her face, pale skin with visible burn scars on her forearm, wears institutional grey clothing — loose sweatshirt and joggers, haunted watchful eyes

cast.name: Gray
cast.role: Antagonist/love interest — calculating predator who reads Avery's trauma like a blueprint. Uses intermittent reinforcement: alternates devastating tenderness with violent control. Called 'demon boy'. Possessive, witty, dangerous.
cast.look: Mid 20s man, tall and imposing, sharp angular features, dark intense eyes, dark hair pushed back, wears fitted dark clothing — black henley and dark trousers, a scar or tattoo visible on his hands, radiates controlled menace

cast.name: Theo
cast.role: Another dangerous inmate who offers Avery a genuine, non-transactional connection. Tattoos over her burn scars as an act of reclaiming her bodily autonomy. Catalyst for the breaking point — his presence fractures Gray's control.
cast.look: Mid 20s man, massive imposing build, dark skin, close-cropped hair, tattoos covering both arms, wears institutional clothing but with rolled-up sleeves showing ink, gentle eyes contrasting his intimidating frame

cast.name: Dr. Smith
cast.role: Avery's assigned psychiatrist. Sterile clinical approach — asks textbook BPD questions, reads off a clipboard. His polite structured method is a language Avery's nervous system does not speak. Contrast to Gray's intuitive predatory reading of her.
cast.look: Middle-aged man, average build, neat grey-streaked hair, wire-rimmed glasses, wears a white lab coat over a dress shirt and tie, carries a clipboard, professional and detached demeanor

cast.name: Sam
cast.role: Hostile inmate at Lilyale. Inherently aggressive. Gray violently defends Avery from him. Theo permanently tattoos a fist onto his face as punishment.
cast.look: Young man, stocky aggressive build, shaved head, scarred knuckles, wears stained institutional clothes, perpetual sneer

cast.name: Saoon
cast.role: Inmate dealing with extreme bipolar swings and the recent suicide of her brother. Part of the hostile environment that pushes Avery toward isolation.
cast.look: Young woman, thin and fragile, dark circles under her eyes, dark curly hair often unkempt, wears oversized institutional clothing, alternates between manic energy and hollow stillness

cast.name: Everyman
cast.role: Abstract stand-in for the reader/viewer — the one rooting for the villain, the one whose nervous system is being hacked by the narrative.
cast.look: Androgynous figure, average build, neutral features, muted earth-tone clothing
